raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Pennsylvania Natural Heritage Program document that stated “between these two points are the mouths of both Ridley Creek and Crum Creek” along the Delaware River. They incorrectly concluded that Crum Creek’s mouth is Ridley Creek, rather than recognizing that both creeks have their mouths on the Delaware River. This unverified assumption (instead of checking an authoritative source like USGS/Wikipedia) led the solution toward the wrong downstream watercourse; the correct mouth is the Delaware River.
